meta.title: Contact — CROIX
meta.description: Send architectural drawings, reflected ceiling plans, mood images, and your target schedule to CROIX for a lighting design or photometric verification proposal.

hero.title: Send the drawings.
hero.intro: DWG, RVT, or PDF. Add mood images, your preferred package, and a target schedule. We will review the drawings and come back with a clear fee proposal within a few days.

supplierNote.label: For suppliers & contractors
supplierNote.body: Have a fixture list or a tender? Use the same form and note “supplier tender” in the project notes. Photometric verification has its own fast-track scope.

steps.title: No black box.
steps.intro: The first reply is not a sales deck. It is a review of your drawings, a short set of questions, and a scope that matches the stage you are actually at.

items.title: We review the drawings
items.body: We check the scope, the project stage, and the technical questions that need an answer before a fee can be meaningful.

items.title: We confirm the brief
items.body: A short call or email aligns the package, the deliverables, the schedule, and who else is in the design team.

items.title: You receive a fee proposal
items.body: A clear scope and fee — usually within a few days — with the assumptions and exclusions stated up front.

cta.title: Send the drawings.
cta.text: DWG, RVT, or PDF. Add mood images, your preferred package, and a target schedule. We will review the drawings and come back with a clear fee proposal within a few days.
